outcome: neonatal postnatal hospital stay lasting more than 72 hours
cohort: Pregnant patients who delivered a viable singleton between 24 and 42 weeks of gestation at a large academic hospital from 2013 to 2021.
finding: Pregnant patients with a documented penicillin allergy history had a higher risk of postpartum endometritis and a higher risk of their neonates having a postnatal hospital stay lasting more than 72 hours.
